scenarios.scenario: Execute real coding and quality work through the sandbox while leaving the host unchanged.
scenarios.environment: Checkout-owned isolated Compose stack, sandbox service and container engine.
preconditions: The complete verifier created a fresh isolated runtime for the corrective checkout.
execution: Execute sandbox integration, coding, timeout, cancellation, recovery and forged-origin scenarios.
expected: Commands stay inside disposable sandboxes, adverse termination remains fail-closed and cleanup completes.
observed: The canonical verifier passed all six sandbox stages and removed the isolated project.

scenarios.scenario: Reproduce a stored quality run under its frozen plan and snapshot identity.
scenarios.environment: Isolated stack with Temporal, PostgreSQL, MinIO, evaluator and sandbox services.
preconditions: A complete immutable quality run was created by the canonical verifier.
expected: The reproduced run has distinct identity and equivalent results without rewriting the original.
observed: quality-reproduction passed in the complete 42-stage verifier.

scenarios.scenario: Restart the evaluator during active work, cancel another run and allow a third to exceed its policy deadline.
scenarios.environment: Checkout-owned live evaluator, Temporal, persistence and sandbox services.
preconditions: Active quality runs and slow fixtures were created by the verifier.
expected: Recovery resumes the same run without duplicates; cancellation and timeout finish cleanup and derive FAIL.
observed: All three adverse lifecycle stages passed in the complete verifier.

scenarios.feature: Truthful PASS, FAIL and canonical IACode evaluation
scenarios.scenario: Run passing, deliberately failing and repository-wide IACode fixtures through the complete Quality Engine.
scenarios.environment: Isolated evaluator stack with immutable evidence stores and canonical project profile.
preconditions: Passing and failing fixtures and the repository snapshot were available to the built images.
expected: Only complete successful evidence derives PASS; the deliberate defect remains FAIL; IACode uses its canonical profile.
observed: All three verdict stages passed in the complete verifier.

scenarios.scenario: Execute the fixed twenty-attack A-T battery, including detached transport rebuild and pre-persistence secret containment.
scenarios.environment: Rebuilt evaluator image plus host review-bundle boundary and current live adverse-scenario reports.
preconditions: The null-mutation control derived PASS and the review transport contained every mandatory artifact category.
execution: Mutate results, evidence, policy, origins, lifecycle, persisted objects and review-bundle transport.
expected: Every mandatory mutation is defended and no credential-shaped evidence becomes durable.
observed: The internal battery defended 20 of 20 attacks, and quality-false-pass passed in the complete verifier.
